name: ecc
description: Unofficial Codex adapter fork of ECC: shared agent skills, a Codex orchestration router, MCP routing policy, TDD, security review, code review, and verification workflows.

author.name: Affaan Mustafa; unofficial Codex adaptation by YBsmorom

interface.shortDescription: Unofficial ECC fork with Codex routing and MCP policy for TDD, security, code review, and autonomous development.
interface.longDescription: This unofficial fork packages ECC for Codex. It preserves the original MIT-licensed ECC surface while adding a Codex-facing orchestration router, generated skill index, routing map, MCP duplicate policy, and install documentation so Codex can lazily select the right ECC skills, scripts, docs, and MCP servers for each task.
interface.developerName: Affaan Mustafa; unofficial Codex adaptation by YBsmorom
defaultPrompt: Use ecc-codex-orchestrator to route this task through the right ECC surfaces.
